title: Caving Cadets Homeschool Series (Sequiota Cave Exploration)
seo_title: Caving Cadets: Sequiota Cave Exploration in Springfield
description: Caving Cadets Homeschool Series is an outdoor Sequiota Cave exploration program on Friday, November 20, 2026 at 11:00 AM. It takes place at Sequiota Park, 3500 S Lone Pine in Springfield, Missouri, and is open to a general audience.
